Firm Overview & Ethos

Professional Expertise. Partner-Led Approach.

Y K Chaturvedi & Co. is a partnership firm of Chartered Accountants registered with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI), established on 02 September 2017 and practises from two offices in Vasai, Dist. Palghar.

The firm serves corporates, LLPs, partnership firms, MSMEs, trusts, societies, and individuals with comprehensive audit, taxation, certification, regulatory compliance, business setup, and advisory services—with partner review of every engagement.

Audit & Assurance

02

Direct Taxation

End-to-end income tax return filing, TDS/TCS compliance, faceless assessments, appeals before CIT(A), and transition advisory for Income-tax Act 2025.

Income Tax Returns of individuals, HUFs, firms, LLPs, companies and trusts
TDS / TCS returns, correction statements and lower-deduction applications
Faceless assessment, reassessment and rectification proceedings

03

Goods & Services Tax (GST)

Complete GST compliance, GSTR-1/3B/9/9C filing, Section 54 refund processing, departmental audits, show cause notices, and GST Appellate Tribunal representation.

GST registration, amendments and cancellation / revocation
Monthly / quarterly / annual returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9 / 9C)
GST Refunds under Section 54 of the CGST Act – exports, inverted duty structure and excess cash balance
+ 5 more specialized services
